proof_body:
by
  intro p _ hp2
  have hP := (Fact.out : p.Prime)
  have hodd : p % 2 = 1 := hP.eq_two_or_odd.resolve_left hp2
  have hmod : p % 4 ≠ 3 ↔ p % 4 = 1 := by omega
  rw [← hmod, ← ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨PadicInt.toZMod z, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg PadicInt.toZMod hz
    simp only [map_pow, map_neg, map_one] at this
    rw [← this, sq]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_surjective y
    let a : PadicInt p := n
    let u : PadicInt p := -1
    have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by simp [u]
    have h1 : PadicInt.toZMod (a ^ 2 - u) = 0 := by
      simp only [a, u, map_sub, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_natCast]
      rw [sq, ← hy]; simp
    have hm : a ^ 2 - u ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicInt p) := by
      rw [← PadicInt.ker_toZMod]; exact h1
    have hlt : ‖a ^ 2 - u‖ < 1 := PadicInt.not_isUnit_iff.1 ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 hm)
    have ha : ‖a‖ = 1 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hl : ‖a‖ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (PadicInt.norm_le_one a) hne
      have h2 : ‖a ^ 2‖ < 1 := by rw [norm_pow]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
      have h3 : ‖a ^ 2 - u‖ = 1 := by
        have := PadicInt.norm_add_eq_max_of_ne (q := a ^ 2) (r := -u) (by rw [norm_neg, hu]; exact h2.ne)
        rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, norm_neg, hu, max_eq_right h2.le] at this
        exact this
      linarith
    have h2n : ‖(2 : PadicInt p)‖ = 1 := by
      have := PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff (p := p) (n := 2)
      have h' := this.2 (((Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 (fun h => hp2 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_two hP).1 h).symm)).symm)
      simpa using h'
    let F : Polynomial (PadicInt p) := Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C u
    have hF : ∀ z, Polynomial.eval z F = z ^ 2 - u := by intro z; simp [F]
    have hF' : Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative F) = 2 * a := by
      simp [F]; left; exact one_add_one_eq_two
    have hl : ‖Polynomial.aeval a F‖ < ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', norm_mul, h2n, ha]; simpa using hlt
    obtain ⟨z, hz, _, _, _⟩ := hensels_lemma hl
    simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF] at hz
    exact ⟨z, sub_eq_zero.1 hz⟩
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ≠ 2 → ((∃ z : PadicInt p, z ^ 2 = -1) ↔ p % 4 = 1)
